% Transparency in a CMYK document: PDF/X-4 wants the page's blend colour space declared.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[cmyk]{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \fill[cyan] (0,0) rectangle (3,2);
  \fill[magenta,opacity=0.5] (1.5,0.5) rectangle (4.5,2.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
